, there was a big mountain. On top of the mountain, there was a pretty tree. The tree had many fruits, but they were all sour. A little girl named Lily wanted to make the tree pretty too.

As the fruits grew on the tree, Lily and her friends saw the pretty colors. They all came to the tree and saw the sour fruits. They were very happy and played under the tree. The tree was happy too. And so, they all lived happily ever after.
